docs.title: MSP documentation
docs.text:
Model Sensing Protocol lets processes on a machine — or across a LAN — discover each other, call each other's tools, and broadcast events. A node announces itself with a lease, so "what is running right now" is something you read rather than something you configure.

This is the working guide. The normative text lives in the specification; the reasoning behind the design lives in the positioning document.

docs.title: Start here
docs.text: Page What it answers Introduction install, run two nodes, call across them — five minutes Architecture & concepts node, preset, tool, signal, lease, connection Why MSP, not MCP what the two protocols actually differ on, including costs Provide tools and signals expose capabilities, publish events, task patterns Discover, call, subscribe discovery vs connection, error semantics, subscriptions FAQ & troubleshooting symptom → cause table, and how to narrow it down Glossary terms, one line each, with where they live in the source

docs.title: Two things worth knowing before you write code
docs.text:
Signals are fire-and-forget. Nothing is retained; a subscriber that was offline missed it. Treat a signal as "something changed" and fetch the state with a tool.

MSP has no gossip. A node sees only its own edges; there is no "who are your neighbours" query in the protocol. Any topology view above observed is either self-reported by a peer or inferred — and should be labelled as such.

docs.title: 节点（node）
docs.text:
一个进程里的参与者。构造时给一个 id，就是它在网络里的名字：

node = MSPNode("weather", preset=Preset.LOCAL_TOOL)

id 必须匹配 ^[a-z0-9_-]+$——小写、数字、下划线、连字符，没有点、没有大写。

id 会影响连接方向。 两个节点互相发现时会同时拨号，MSP 按字典序挑一个方向、关掉另一条： node_id 更小的那方负责出站。这不是安全机制，只是去重规则；但给云节点起名时要注意 （字典序在前的节点会成为主动出站方）。

docs.title: 预置（preset）
docs.text:
预设决定这个节点具备哪些能力，不用逐个装：

preset 用途 Preset.LOCAL_TOOL 本机工具提供者：宣告工具、可被发现 Preset.FULL_PEER 完整对等节点：既能被调也能调别人、能订阅广播 Preset.LOCAL_AI AI 应用侧：连本机工具、默认懒连接 Preset.CLOUD_SERVICE 云端服务节点 Preset.OBSERVER 只观察不提供能力 Preset.MANUAL_PEER 只有手动指定的对端，不自动发现

docs.title: 工具（tool）
docs.text:
请求-应答。调用方发起、拿结果、有超时：

@node.tool("get_weather", "查询城市天气")
def get_weather(location: str, days: int = 3) -> dict:
    ...
  • 返回值会被包成 ToolResult，调用方用 result.structured 或 result.unwrap() 取
  • 出错不抛异常：result.is_error 为真，result.error 里是原因
  • input_schema 默认从类型注解生成，仅用于对外宣告，不参与运行时校验

docs.title: 信号（signal）
docs.text:
广播。发出去就不管了，收不收、收几条都不由发送方保证：

node.declare_signal("weather.updated", description="天气数据更新")
node.publish("weather.updated", {"location": "杭州", "temp_c": 21})

对面这样收：

@node.on("weather.*")            # 支持 * 与 ** 通配
def handle(sig):
    print(sig.path, sig.payload)

信号没有留存：没连上时发的就永远丢了，重连也不会补发。要"当前值"必须自己拉一次快照 （用工具查），把信号当成"变化通知"而不是状态。

docs.title: 租约（lease）与发现
docs.text:
节点启动时往发现目录写一份自己的声明文件（文件名 = 节点 id），运行期间续租； 其它节点扫描这个目录。30 秒没续租 = 视为已死，目录里的旧文件会被忽略。

含义：崩溃不需要清理，重启自动出现，"现在有什么在跑"是一个随时可读的事实。

docs.title: 连接（connection）
docs.text:
一条已建立的 TCP 长连接。握手时双方交换 manifest（工具、信号、能力），之后：

  • 心跳：15 秒 PING，45 秒无响应判失联
  • 断线时所有挂起的调用立刻失败返回，不会白等到超时
  • 一个节点可以与多个邻居同时保持连接

docs.title: 线格式（wire）
docs.text:
8 个顶层字段恒定的 JSON，前面加 4 字节大端长度前缀：

{"type":"tool_call","source":"agent","pattern":null,"target":"weather",
 "path":null,"reqid":"r1","payload":{"tool":"get_weather","args":{...}},"timestamp":1761000000.0}

未知的顶层字段会被保守地保留在 extras 里并原样回显——这是给协议演进留的余地。

docs.title: 使用能力：发现、调用、订阅
发现
docs.text:
node.start()
print(node.neighbors())        # 已知的邻居 id
print(node.connections())      # 已经连上的邻居 id
print(node.peer_manifest("weather"))   # 对方宣告的原始清单

neighbors() 与 connections() 的差别很重要：邻居已知 ≠ 连接已建立。默认 connect_policy="eager" 会主动去连，"lazy" 则等到真要调用时才连。

docs.title: start() 会不会阻塞
docs.text:
start(settle=True)（默认）会等这次启动过程中由发现触发的建连全部落地，最多 settle_timeout（默认 0.5 秒），返回是否在超时前稳定。所以：

  • 启动后立刻 publish / call 不会打到空的连接集合上
  • 但它只等、不发起——不会为了"稳定"去连新的节点
  • 懒连接模式下它是空操作

想手动再稳一次：

node.start(settle=False)
node.settle(1.0)

docs.title: 调用工具
docs.text:
result = node.call("weather", "get_weather", {"location": "杭州"}, timeout=5.0)

失败不抛异常，返回带错误的 ToolResult：

if result.is_error:
    print("失败:", result.error)      # 对端不可达 / 未知工具 / 超时 / 中途断开
else:
    data = result.structured          # 工具函数返回的 dict

两个便利方法：

用法 行为 result.unwrap() 成功返回 structured，失败抛 ToolError result.text() 把所有 text 块拼成字符串

成功时 result.error 是空字符串，不是 None——判断成功请用 is_error 或 if result.error:， 不要写 if result.error is None。

docs.title: 订阅广播
docs.text:
@node.on("weather.*")
def handle(sig):
    print(sig.path, sig.payload, sig.source)
  • 路径支持 *（单段）与 **（多段）
  • node.on(None) 收全部
  • 处理函数在独立线程里跑（保序、不阻塞读循环）；慢回调不会拖住心跳

docs.title: 信号会丢，这是设计
docs.text:
信号是广播、没有留存：没连上时发的就永久丢失，重连也不补发。所以正确的用法是 "信号当变化通知，状态靠工具去查"：

@node.on("download.completed")
def done(sig):
    # 不信任 payload 是完整状态，回查一次
    task = node.call("downloader", "get_task", {"taskId": sig.payload["taskId"]}).unwrap()
    ...

docs.title: 断线与重连
docs.text:
• 心跳 15 秒 PING、45 秒无响应判失联
  • 失联时所有挂起的调用立刻失败返回，不会白等到超时
  • 重连由发现机制负责：节点的声明还在目录里，下一轮扫描会重新拨过去
  • 想感知状态：
node.on_connected(lambda peer: print("连上", peer))
node.on_disconnected(lambda peer: print("断开", peer))

docs.title: 观测
docs.text:
print(node.metrics())

计数覆盖：连接（opened/replaced/condemned）、信号（accepted/out/rejected/broadcastSkipped）、 工具（dispatched/rejected/shed）、任务线程（active/peak）。

排查时先看 metrics_line()：signalsRejected>0 通常是授权问题，broadcastSkipped>0 说明 对方没订阅那条路径（协议上这是正常的，不是错误）。

docs.title: MSP 和 MCP 是什么关系？
docs.text:
不是替代关系，是形状不同：MCP 是 hub-and-spoke 的工具协议，MSP 是网状的对等协议——节点有租约 （存在感）、能主动广播（推送）、能互相直接服务。为什么这决定了本地软件该用哪个，见 [docs/POSITIONING.zh-CN.md(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/docs/POSITIONING.zh-CN.md)。

仓库里的 mcp/ 是互操作适配层：把 MCP server 包成 MSP 节点，而不是让运行时同时说两种协议。

docs.title: 为什么不直接用 stdio 的 MCP？
docs.text: stdio 的生命周期绑在会话上：客户端拉起进程，会话结束进程就死；而且拉起的是第二个实例， 看不到你屏幕上开着的那个文档。桌面软件要的是"软件活着能力就在"，这一点 stdio 结构上给不了。

docs.title: 能给两台机器用吗？
docs.text: 可以，TCP 本来就能跨机。但要自己解决：地址与发现（发现目录是本机的，跨机要么共享目录、要么用 add_manual_source / 手动指定对端）、TLS（WebSocket 传输目前没有 wss://，需要反向代理终结 TLS）、以及授权（跨机默认不是"可达即信任"）。

docs.title: Windows 上有些用例被跳过
docs.text: Windows 没有 AF_UNIX，tests/test_uds.py 的 4 个 UDS 用例会自动 skip——不是失败。

docs.title: 同一台机器跑多个节点要注意什么？
docs.text:
• 节点 id 必须互不相同：id 是连接表的键，两个进程同 id 会在对端眼里变成同一个 peer，后连的 把先连的踢掉
  • 想隔离就各用各的 nodes_dir

docs.title: 排查表
docs.text: 症状 先查什么 常见原因 neighbors() 是空的 两边 nodes_dir 是否同一个目录；目录里有没有对方的 <id>.json 目录不同；id 含非法字符（大写/点号）；声明超过 30 秒没续租 邻居有，connections() 没有 对方端口是否可达；防火墙 端口被拦；对方已退出但声明还没过期 call() 报"未连接/未知节点" ensure_connected(peer_id) 的异常信息 名字打错；对方没宣告这个工具 call() 超时 对方的 metrics_line() 里 dispatched 有没有涨 工具函数卡住（同步阻塞操作）；timeout 设太短 收不到信号 发布方的 metrics_line()：broadcastSkipped 发布方按 sub 授权过滤掉了你；或你订阅的路径模式不匹配 信号收到一半就没了 连接是否重建过 信号没有留存，断线期间的发不补 连接数反复涨跌（replaced 在涨） 两个节点是否用了同一个 id id 冲突；或两个节点同时反复重连 同一路径的信号被拒（signalsRejected） 授权表 跨机时默认不放行未授权路径

docs.title: 定位手段（按顺序）
docs.text:
1. 发现层：ls ~/.msp/nodes/，看对方的 <id>.json 在不在、时间戳新不新
  2. 连接层：node.connections()；对方 peer_manifest("我") 能不能看到我
  3. 能力层：node.peer_manifest("对方") 里有没有那个工具/信号
  4. 计数层：两边都打印 metrics_line()，看是"没发出"还是"没收到"
  5. 线上报文：真需要时，把连接换成本地 socket 抓一次 4 字节长度前缀 + JSON

docs.title: 调试时最省事的两条
docs.text:
node = MSPNode("probe", preset=Preset.FULL_PEER)
node.start()
print(node.neighbors(), node.connections())        # 发现 + 连接
print(node.peer_manifest("weather"))               # 对方到底宣告了什么

docs.title: 还是不通
docs.text:
把这几样一起贴出来，比描述现象有用得多：

  • 两边节点的 id、preset、nodes_dir
  • ls -l <nodes_dir> 的结果（看声明文件时间戳）
  • 两边的 metrics_line()
  • 操作系统与 Python 版本

docs.title: 术语表
docs.text:
按在协议里的层次从低到高排。

术语 英文 一句话 在哪 信号 signal 一条带路径的 JSON 报文；8 个顶层字段恒定，未知字段进 extras [core/signal.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/signal.py) 分帧 framing 4 字节大端长度前缀 + UTF-8 JSON [protocol/framing.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/protocol/framing.py) 清单 manifest 节点宣告自己的工具、信号、能力、模式 [core/manifest.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/manifest.py) 握手 handshake HELLO（带 manifest）→ ACK（带回对方 manifest） [protocol/protocol.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/protocol/protocol.py) 去重仲裁 dedup / canonical direction 两个节点同时拨号时，按 node_id 字典序保留一个方向 同上 工具 tool 请求-应答的能力，有名字、描述、输入 schema [core/node.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/node.py) 调用 call 调对端工具，返回 ToolResult；失败不抛异常 同上 广播 publish / broadcast 发一条信号给所有已订阅的对端；发完即忘、无留存 同上 订阅 subscription 用路径模式（* / **）注册本地回调 [protocol/matcher.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/protocol/matcher.py) 发现 discovery 扫描共享目录，把新节点变成可拨的对端 [discovery/(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/tree/master/src/msp/discovery/) 宣告 presence 往共享目录写自己的声明文件并续租 [presence/(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/tree/master/src/msp/presence/) 租约 lease 声明的有效期：30 秒没有续租即视为失联 同上 预置 preset 一组能力的打包：发现、宣告、传输、模式、连接策略 [core/preset.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/preset.py) 连接策略 connect policy eager（发现即连）/ lazy（用到才连） 同上 稳定 settle 等"这次启动触发的建连"落地，只等不发起 [core/node.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/node.py) 模式 pattern 可插拔的交互形状：request-reply / publish-subscribe / multi-round / task [patterns/(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/tree/master/src/msp/patterns/) 任务 task multi-round 的一种：有队列、有状态、可回查 [patterns/task.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/patterns/task.py) 授权 grant 按 (对端, 路径模式) 决定能不能发/收/调；跨机默认不信任 [protocol/protocol.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/protocol/protocol.py) 本机对端 local peer 回环 TCP 或 UDS 连接的对端，默认视为本机 同上 指标 metrics 连接 / 信号 / 工具 / 任务线程各维度的计数 [core/node.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/core/node.py) 适配层 adapter 把 MCP server 包成一个 MSP 节点的那一层 [mcp/(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/tree/master/src/msp/mcp/)

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text: 五分钟内跑通两个节点：一个提供一个工具，另一个发现它并调用。

docs.title: 1. 安装
docs.text:
pip install --pre msp-py        # PyPI 上目前是预发布版本
# 或者从源码：
pip install -e .

pip install -e . 是"可编辑"安装，改源码立刻生效（建议在虚拟环境里）。

docs.title: 2. 提供能力的一方
docs.text:
存成 weather.py：

from msp import MSPNode, Preset

node = MSPNode("weather", preset=Preset.LOCAL_TOOL)


@node.tool("get_weather", "查询城市天气")
def get_weather(location: str, days: int = 3) -> dict:
    return {"location": location, "days": days, "temp_c": 21}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    node.start()
    input("按回车退出\n")

@node.tool 不只注册函数，还会把工具声明进自己的能力清单——邻居握手时就能看到它。

docs.title: 3. 使用能力的一方
docs.text:
存成 agent.py，两个终端各跑一个：

from msp import MSPNode, Preset

node = MSPNode("agent", preset=Preset.FULL_PEER)
node.start()

print("邻居:", node.neighbors())

result = node.call("weather", "get_weather", {"location": "杭州"})
print("结果:", result.unwrap() if not result.is_error else result.error)

两秒内你应该看到 邻居: ['weather'] 和一份 JSON。

docs.title: 4. 它们是怎么互相找到的
docs.text:
默认都往同一个目录写"我在这里"的声明、并轮询这个目录：

~/.msp/nodes/weather.json     ← 节点 id 就是文件名
~/.msp/nodes/agent.json
  • 节点启动时写入自己的端点（host/port），运行期间每 5–10 秒续租
  • 其它节点扫描目录，发现新文件就拨过去
  • 超过 30 秒没续租的声明会被忽略——进程崩了不需要谁去清理

想换目录就传 nodes_dir=。同一台机器上两个节点用不同目录，就互相看不见。

docs.title: 5. 下一步
docs.text:
• 想暴露更多接口、想主动推送 → [提供能力(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/docs/03-provide.md)
  • 想看调用失败怎么办、怎么订阅广播 → [使用能力(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/docs/04-consume.md)
  • 想一次跑完整个例子（不需要开两个终端）→ PYTHONPATH=src python docs/wiki/examples/two_nodes.py

docs.title: 提供能力：把工具和信号暴露出去
注册工具
docs.text:
@node.tool("get_weather", "查询城市天气")
def get_weather(location: str, days: int = 3) -> dict:
    return {"location": location, "days": days, "temp_c": 21}

三样东西会被写进能力清单，邻居握手时就能看到：名字、描述、输入 schema。

docs.title: schema 从哪来
docs.text:
默认从函数签名的类型注解生成：

from typing import Annotated

@node.tool("search", "在本地文件里搜索")
def search(
    pattern: Annotated[str, "正则表达式"],
    path: Annotated[str, "搜索根目录"] = ".",
    limit: Annotated[int, "最多返回条数"] = 50,
) -> dict:
    ...

想完全自己控制就显式传：

node.tool("raw", "手工描述", input_schema={"type": "object", "properties": {...}})

schema 只用于对外宣告，不做运行时校验——别指望它挡住非法参数，工具函数自己要防御。

docs.title: 返回值怎么变成结果
docs.text: 工具函数返回的 dict 进 ToolResult.structured。想返回富内容（文本/图片块）就返回 MCP 风格的内容块， 见 [src/msp/mcp/(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/tree/master/src/msp/mcp/)。

docs.title: 发布信号
docs.text:
两步：声明会发布哪条路径，然后发布。

node.declare_signal("weather.updated", description="天气数据更新")

node.publish("weather.updated", {"location": "杭州", "temp_c": 21})

publish 是发完即忘的：不等待、没有回执、没人订阅也不报错。

docs.title: 把外部事件源接进来
docs.text:
有个后台线程/监听器不断产生事件时，用 signal_source 装饰一个无参生成器，节点启动后会自动迭代并发布：

@node.signal_source("system.file.modified")
def watch():
    for event in watch_downloads_folder():     # 你自己的阻塞迭代器
        yield {"path": str(event.path), "size": event.size}

注意这个函数必须是生成器（里面要有 yield），而且不能带参数——@node.signal 是它的别名。

docs.title: 声明的意义
docs.text: declare_signal 会把路径写进 manifest，邻居才知道"这个节点会发这类信号"，也才谈得上按路径授权 （sub 授权是按路径模式匹配的，不是按内容）。不声明也能发，但没人知道该期待它。

docs.title: 批量改清单：defer_manifest
docs.text:
一次注册十几个工具时，逐个推清单很浪费。用上下文管理器攒成一次：

with node.defer_manifest():
    for name, fn in handlers.items():
        node.tool(name, "")(fn)

它只影响清单推送，不是通用并发原语。

docs.title: 长任务：任务模式
docs.text: get_task / list_tasks 这种"有队列、要回查"的能力，用 msp/task 模式比裸工具更省事—— 调用方拿到的是一份可回查的任务快照。见 [src/msp/patterns/task.py(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/src/msp/patterns/task.py) 与 [docs/DESIGN.md(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/docs/DESIGN.md) 里"任务"一节。

docs.title: 检查自己宣告了什么
docs.text:
node.start()
print(node.exposed_bindings())     # 本节点对外暴露的工具与信号
print(node.metrics_line())         # 连接 / 信号 / 工具各维度的计数

metrics_line() 是排查"对方到底有没有发过来"的第一手证据。

docs.title: Positioning: neighbours, not sockets
docs.text:
This document answers one question: for local software talking to AI, why MSP rather than MCP? It is not a "protocol war" argument — it is about shape.

中文版（含原文表述）：[POSITIONING.zh-CN.md(https://github.com/hxh230802/MSP/blob/master/docs/POSITIONING.zh-CN.md)

docs.title: MCP and MSP are not the same kind of thing
docs.text:
MCP MSP Topology hub-and-spoke: the model is the centre, every server attaches to it mesh: nodes are peers, the agent is just one of them Direction pull-dominant: the model asks pull and push: an app can broadcast when something happens Presence one entry in a config file leases: what is running right now is a fact you can read Lifetime one call, one session long-lived connection + heartbeat + multi-round / task semantics App-to-app must go through the model direct (A's capability can serve B)

So for the vision "every piece of local software can interact with AI", MCP has the wrong shape: it assumes software is a pile of passive tools, whereas what we want is a pile of stateful neighbours that speak up and know each other. Wrapping MCP in a shim is not merely complex — it compresses a mesh into a hub and throws away push and presence, the two things actually worth having.

docs.title: 1. Lifecycle ownership — stdio gets it backwards
docs.text:
stdio:          the agent spawns the process -> session ends, process dies -> capability dies with the session
resident server: the app runs its own server -> app lives, capability lives -> capability follows the software

"Presence" requires that a capability exists while the software runs. stdio ties it to a session instead, with two concrete consequences:

  • State fidelity is lost: what the client spawns is a second instance that does not know which document the user has open.
  • Multi-client mutual exclusion breaks: two agents spawn two copies → two writers on one file.

docs.title: 2. Presence must be "known right now", not "written down once"
docs.text: Leases make "what is running" a fact that can be read at any moment instead of a list somebody has to maintain. A crashed node disappears; a restarted one reappears — nobody has to synchronise state.

docs.title: 3. Speaking up is what local software does
docs.text: A download finishes, playback changes, a file lands, a device is plugged in — these happen in the software, not in the model's question. Only push carries them where they are needed.

docs.title: Three transport shapes
docs.text:
Dimension stdio streamable HTTP MSP WebSocket transport Lifecycle owner client app ✓ app ✓ Talks to the running instance ✗ ✓ ✓ Stable address ✗ has a port, but nobody knows which directory declaration + lease ✓ Push ✗ yes, on the same stream, but the client must stay connected full duplex ✓ Multi-client one process per client ✗ ✓ ✓ Discovery none needed (spawned) the user types a URL ✗ automatic ✓

stdio is a convention for wiring tools (fine for filesystem, git, sqlite — stateless or with state on disk), not a convention for neighbours.

Streamable HTTP fixes the lifecycle but hands discovery straight back to you: the user still has to know http://127.0.0.1:8721/mcp, and has to know whether it changed today. Whatever transport MCP uses, the missing piece is the same: a stable addressing layer that appears and disappears by itself. MCP has never standardised it; it always defers to config files.

Practical traps on Windows: a fixed port collides, a dynamic port needs a declaration file even more; binding 0.0.0.0 triggers a firewall prompt while 127.0.0.1 stays quiet; any local process can hit the port, so authorisation ends up being "put a token in a file and let file permissions be the credential" — exactly the MSP lease idea. And the ecosystem reality: most MCP servers are still stdio, because early clients only supported stdio.

docs.title: What this choice costs us
docs.text:
Choosing MSP keeps the supply-side cost on our own books. MCP has a ready ecosystem (thousands of servers, vendor support); we give up that free supply.

And to be honest: MSP's adoption problem is the same problem MCP has — some app has to implement it. A discovery mechanism does not fix "nobody wants to implement it".

The trade is worth making, but make it deliberately, and do not come back later asking "why is there no ecosystem". It is a chosen cost, not an oversight.

docs.title: The boundary: one protocol at runtime, MCP only at import time
docs.text:
Do not maintain a dual-protocol runtime. Put MCP at import time, not at runtime:

The runtime speaks MSP only. MCP appears exactly once, during conversion.

Conversion (once):
  run a tool -> start the MCP server -> call tools/list -> record the tool list -> write a declaration

Runtime (forever after):
  agent -- MSP --> [adapter process] -- MCP --> the original app
                        ^
              an ordinary MSP node that happens to speak MCP internally

The point: the agent side never knows MCP exists. It sees "there is a node called wps with six tools".

Wrapper (permanent dual protocol) Adapter (one-time move) Core code gains an MCP branch untouched Config gains an endpoint type none; the node announces itself When it breaks "MSP, the shim, or the server?" the node is offline; the panel shows it Enable / disable edit the core stop the process Replace it touches the core swap the adapter

A wrapper invites the translator into the driver's seat; a move unloads the van and the translator leaves.

One honest clarification: the tool list can be moved once, but calls still have to reach the app — you cannot rewrite WPS in MSP. So the accurate statement is "MCP lives only inside a separate adapter process, and that process is just an ordinary MSP node to the agent". The value is not "MCP vanished" but:

  1. the core stays single-protocol (one failure mode, one debugging story);
  2. MCP's mess is isolated in the layer that is easiest to write, drop and replace;
  3. that shell has the same shape as the SDK for native apps — so there is one integration shape, not two.

docs.title: Rule of thumb
docs.text:
"Does this app have user-visible state?"

  • Yes (editors, players, download managers, IDEs) → it should be a native MSP node hosting its own server.
  • No (filesystem, git, web scraping, SQLite) → wrap it in an adapter; do not rework the app.

docs.title: Open questions (honest list)
docs.text:
1. An OS-level discovery convention: the mechanism exists (lease directory); what is missing is vendors willing to write it. An ecosystem problem, not a technical one.
  2. A 20-line SDK for C#/C++/Node/Python: declaration, forwarding, heartbeat included. Authors should be filling in three fields, not implementing a protocol.
  3. One-time consent: discovery-as-trust is a hole locally (any process can claim to be WPS). Ask once, "allow this app?", then stay quiet.
  4. Tool explosion: 30 local apps × 10 tools = 300 schemas, which blows up the context window. Auto-discovery turns "resident catalogue, on-demand contracts" from an optimisation into a necessity.

docs.title: In one sentence
docs.text: MSP is not selling "yet another tool protocol"; it sells presence for local software — it knows who is connected to it, it can speak up when something happens, and it can work with its neighbours directly. MCP's structure cannot give you those three.

docs.title: The most painful example
docs.text:
You say: "delete the third row of the sheet I just opened." The sheet is on your screen, never saved, titled "Workbook1". Under stdio, the agent spawns a second WPS process: its window list is empty, there is no "Workbook1", so all it can answer is: "Please give me the file path." — and you have not even named it yet.

That is the shape problem: you and the agent are not looking at the same software.
